name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Color Mint
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**What are you trying to do?**
The problem or the wish, in your own words. For example: "I always have to open dconf-editor to change...".

**What would you like Color Mint to do?**
What you would expect to find: a button or field in a tab (which one?), a terminal command (what would it look like?), or something automatic.

**What do you do today instead?**
Any workaround or alternative you have tried.

**Which desktops would it touch?**
Cinnamon only, or does it matter on other distributions too?

**Additional context**
Screenshots, links to a theme or a project that does it well, anything else.

Color Mint tries to stay a single script that does one thing well, with the least effort for the user, so a short explanation of why this belongs here helps a lot.
